name: Puerto Vallarta
queryAndRequestSummary: Separate English and Spanish first-party discovery identified the Jalisco Catastro eCarto public map and the Puerto Vallarta municipal Sub Dirección de Catastro. The current map HTML/configuration was followed to map 808 and its UTFGrid tile route. A bounded exact-point request returned only manzana/redvial map-feature metadata and no parcel polygon or safe parcel ID+geometry response. No sample GeoJSON was retained.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: official cartography page retrieved; current iframe route identified
public eCarto map HTML retrieved; JavaScript/configuration route identified
HTTP 200 map configuration; statewide tile layers and UTFGrid metadata observed
HTTP 200 bounded exact-point tile; manzana/redvial IDs only, no parcel polygon
official municipal cadastral procedure page retrieved; no public parcel API exposed
official planning/cadastral-value document index retrieved; no parcel service exposed
official static planning-map index retrieved; no parcel geometry service exposed

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [20.6462709094644, -105.216998614097] was preserved and not shifted; the map tile result is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The bounded UTFGrid response demonstrates public map-feature metadata, not parcel coverage, parcel geometry, legal survey status, or currentness.
No full parcel polygon was available from the inspected anonymous routes, so no retained GeoJSON sample was created.
Municipal cadastral procedure pages evidence a local custodian but describe request-based services and unsafe cadastral/account data; those fields were not requested.

nativeFieldMapping.compositeKeyProvenance: No parcel native identity was observed. The returned ecarto_id values identify non-parcel UTFGrid map features and were not promoted to parcel identities.

uncertainty: A first-party Puerto Vallarta municipal cadastral custodian and a first-party Jalisco public cartographic viewer are evidenced. The source is not admitted: the inspected current public route did not return safe parcel identity+geometry, the exact-point request exposed only non-parcel map features, and municipal pages describe request-based cadastral information. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, or unsafe field request was used.
